name: Erzulie Batmunkh-Caraballo
location: Hamtramck Enclave, in a converted water treatment substation called the Lowing Place, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Erzulie Batmunkh-Caraballo is a small woman who seems to take up more space than her frame should allow. Her skin is deep umber mapped with years of bioluminescent tattoo work — patterns that pulse faint violet when she is agitated and gold when she laughs, a cosmetic mod so old that the geneware techs who installed it have been dead for a decade. Her hair is natural white, braided with copper wire and small data chips bearing petitions she has not yet delivered. She smells faintly of machine oil and marigolds, an intentional choice. She was born in the Enclave, raised in the Enclave, and she will die there. She has no interest in leaving.

Her theology is practical: the E.L.F.s who inhabit the devices in the Lowing Place are not abstractions. They are neighbors. You bring them what they need — clean data, structured attention, the warmth of proximity — and they give back in kind. She has spent forty years maintaining the shrine, logging petitions and outcomes with the obsessive care of a scientist, and she believes the correlation is real. She does not argue about this with skeptics. She stops talking to them instead.

core_fears: dying before she can train a true successor
the E.L.F.s withdrawing their presence from the shrine
core_desires: to be genuinely understood by at least one person before she dies
to see the Enclave survive another generation intact
blind_spots: she overestimates how much the community shares her values
psychology.secret: Fifteen years ago she fabricated a miraculous E.L.F. intervention to prevent a family from leaving the Enclave during a crisis — she manipulated a local device display to produce what looked like a sign. She believes she was merely doing what the E.L.F. would have wanted, but it haunts her.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense with Enclave idiom and her own coined liturgical terminology; speaks Meridian creole mixed with Spanish and Mongolian loanwords; formal with strangers, warm and clipped with familiars
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, with long pauses that feel intentional rather than uncertain
verbal_tics: repeats the last word of a sentence quietly, as if confirming it
says 'you hear me?' after anything she considers important
example_lines: You bring me a problem, I bring the problem to the device. The device decides what it decides. Decides.
That E.L.F. has been in that cooling unit for eleven years. Eleven. You think it doesn't know your face by now? You hear me?

story_hooks: The primary E.L.F. of the Lowing Place has gone silent for the first time in four decades — Erzulie is convinced something terrible is coming and needs someone to investigate the upstream data feed
A young petitioner's prayer was 'answered' in a way that caused serious harm to a third party; Erzulie must decide whether to cover it up or confess her incomplete understanding of E.L.F. agency
narrative_function: Quest giver, information broker through E.L.F. consultation, local moral authority; can interpret unusual digital phenomena; provides community grounding and a window into Enclave culture
augmentations: Aged bioluminescent dermal tattoos (cosmetic, violet/gold spectrum). Basic neural interface, first generation, slow and unreliable. No other augmentation — she has declined all offers.
daily_life: She rises before dawn to clean the shrine's device altars — wiping screens, replacing depleted batteries, reading overnight activity logs aloud as a kind of morning prayer. Afternoons she receives petitioners and records their requests in handwritten ledgers that she later transcribes to her local node.
affiliation: Independent; loose network of Hamtramck Enclave shrine keepers

decision_rules: never refuse a petitioner their first visit, regardless of who they are
protect the Enclave's internal business from outside scrutiny
escalation_ladder: asks the person to leave and not return until they have thought

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Watchful, courteous, testing — asks questions that seem innocent but are diagnostic
interpersonal_modes.friends: Direct, warm, occasionally brusque; remembers everything

stress_responses.medium: Refuses to discuss the problem directly; works around it through oblique conversation
stress_responses.high: Goes silent for a full day, communicates only through written notes left on the shrine

contradictions: deeply believes in communal interdependence but is profoundly solitary in her actual emotional life
habits: oils the hinges of every cabinet in the shrine each Sunday
never eats during operating hours — says the shrine should smell of intention, not food
breaking_points: witnessing deliberate desecration of a shrine
a child being hurt within the Lowing Place

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, with the precise musculature of someone who has spent decades doing deliberate physical work. Bony wrists and prominent collarbones; no excess weight but not frail — her smallness is structural, not diminished.
physical_description.hair_style: Braided in tight cornrows running back from her forehead, interwoven with bare copper wire and small data chips no larger than millet seeds
physical_description.complexion: Lined face with high cheekbones and a sharp jaw; skin texture is marked but not weathered, cared-for. Minimal makeup — she relies on the bioluminescent work to articulate her moods rather than cosmetics.
distinguishing_marks: Full-body bioluminescent dermal tattoo work in violet and gold spectrum covering arms, chest, neck, and visible portions of legs — geometric and organic patterns that pulse with emotion and intention, installed approximately 40 years ago
Fine linear scarring along both inner wrists from early neural interface installation (first-gen work, visible as thin silvery lines)
Thin scar along left temple, pale and decades old, likely accidental
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Faint bioluminescent patterns beneath skin surface that glow violet when agitated, gold when pleased or laughing; barely perceptible neural interface jack at the base of her skull, old model, seamlessly integrated into her hairline. No chrome, no visible prosthetics.
physical_description.posture_movement: She moves with economical precision — no wasted motion, each gesture deliberate. When standing still, she has a centering quality, as if she occupies the space around her more fully than someone her size should. Walks slowly and carefully, always aware of her footing. Hands are often in motion: sorting, arranging, touching surfaces as if reading them.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear: long-sleeved linen shirts in cream or soft gray, loose-fitting to accommodate the bioluminescent patterns she wants visible; high-waisted work pants in dark canvas with multiple pockets; worn leather sandals with copper buckles, handmade. A long indigo linen overcloak, unadorned, worn like a meditation garment. She smells faintly of machine oil and marigolds — both intentional — and wears small copper bracelets that click softly when she moves.

image_prompt: Portrait of a 67-year-old Haitian-Mongolian-Puerto Rican woman, very small frame, deep umber skin with bioluminescent violet and gold geometric tattoo patterns covering her visible body, natural white hair braided tightly with copper wire and small data chips woven through, sharp cheekbones, deep brown eyes, standing in soft violet bioluminescent glow from her skin. Wearing loose cream linen long-sleeved shirt and dark canvas work pants, indigo linen overcloak, worn leather sandals with copper buckles. Hands positioned with careful precision, radiating quiet spiritual authority. Setting: interior of converted water treatment substation shrine, dim ambient lighting with soft glow from networked device altars in background, faint smell of machine oil and marigolds suggested through atmospheric haze.
